direction.label: Precision Instrument
direction.hypothesis: A more architectural relay body makes orchestration legible at thumbnail scale while retaining the porcelain Starlight family

asset.surface: Starlight Research Team character direction review

prompt.primary_request: Evolve Lyra into a role-shaped precision relay instrument while preserving her existing identity and Starlight material language
prompt.scene: A restrained black calibration chamber with one architectural rule line and no decorative interface
prompt.subject: Lyra, the same porcelain-and-obsidian research conductor, embodied as a precise multi-channel relay
prompt.style_medium: high-fidelity industrial character design render with museum-object precision
prompt.composition: full-body four-to-five portrait, eye-level, strong readable shoulder and arm silhouette, hands centered around a tangible routing instrument
prompt.lighting_mood: controlled museum lighting, crisp material separation, calm technical confidence, no global glow
prompt.color_palette: aged porcelain, deep obsidian, brushed titanium, narrow cyan signal channels, external warm amber approval marker
prompt.materials_textures: matte porcelain plates, exposed black mechanisms, calibrated metal rails, minimal ink-blue textile joints
constraints: preserve Lyra's segmented porcelain cranium and narrow black faceplate
make relay architecture visible in collar shoulders forearms and hands
show many bounded channels resolving into one physical output
keep the human approval marker separate from the body
prompt.final_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: 4:5 Starlight character direction preview. Image 1 is the owned Lyra edit target and identity reference. Preserve Lyra's segmented ivory porcelain cranium, narrow black faceplate, calm non-human identity, human-scale proportions, obsidian mechanics, and restrained ink-blue accents. Evolve the body into Precision Instrument: an architectural research-conductor relay with a distinct open radial collar, shoulder-to-forearm signal channels, articulated hands, and one tangible routing instrument that visibly accepts several bounded evidence inputs and produces one physical task packet. Use minimal functional textile only at joints; no cape or robe. Full-body eye-level museum-object portrait in a restrained black calibration chamber with crisp material separation and no pedestal. Narrow cyan channels indicate machine activity; a separate amber approval marker belongs to the human boundary outside the body. Matte porcelain, exposed black mechanisms, brushed titanium, precise seams. No text, no logos, no fake UI, no global glow, no weapons, no combat armor, no crown, throne, divine core, superhero stance, or generic sci-fi armor.

qa.strongest_element: The relay collar, cyan channels, and tangible multi-input router produce the clearest first-glance specialty in the set
qa.weakest_element: The amber chest core violates the visual governance invariant and the wall pictogram reads like an unnecessary interface symbol
qa.next_change: Preserve the full-body relay form and router while moving amber authority entirely onto a physical environmental control
